claims.statement: Allen and Joe Goss met at Cincinnati to draw up articles for their fight and signed them quickly.
claims.excerpt: in coming to terms, and when the men met at Cincinnati

claims.statement: Jem Mace thought of matching Joe Goss against Tom Allen while Mace was in England.
claims.excerpt: thought that it would be a good idea to match Goss against Allen

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Joe Goss were matched to fight on 7 September 1876 for the championship of America.
claims.excerpt: the fight on the seventh of September was to be decided on its merits

claims.statement: Tom Allen had fought Joe Goss to a draw in three rings, as printed.
claims.excerpt: with whom he had fought a draw in three rings

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Jack Madden left St. Louis for Cincinnati about ten days before this article, at the end of their Comique engagement.
claims.excerpt: Allen and Jack Madden left for Cincinnati at the close of their engagement at the Comique ten days ago

claims.statement: Tom Allen wrote in a letter that he had begun work in earnest and was never in better trim in his life.
claims.excerpt: begun work in earnest, and thathe never was in better trim in his life

claims.statement: Tom Allen said the fighting ground for the Goss fight had already been selected.
claims.excerpt: that the fighting ground had already been selected

claims.statement: Tom Allen was interviewed by a Globe-Democrat reporter at the Olive Street Hotel in St. Louis and said the match was on the dead level.
claims.excerpt: in hia room at the Olive Street Hotel

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: It will be the liveliest scrap you ever saw for the first twenty minutes

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: the only way you can lick himisto blind him

fights.excerpt: with whom he had fought a draw in three rings
fights.notes: Only a passing mention. Printed as 'three rings'; no date, place or rounds given.

fights.stakes: a big bundle and the championship of America
fights.excerpt: the fight on the seventh of September was to be decided on its merits
fights.notes: Planned bout as of this article. The stake amount is printed as 'a big bundle'.

notes: Fight date and match details are taken from the article's own description. The Globe-Democrat says the match was made after Mace suggested it. The article also reports that Allen claimed the fighting ground was chosen; the claim is kept as Allen's own statement.
